summary: The Java SDK should validate workflow task payload sizes and fail gracefully when they exceed known limits, preventing runtime errors and providing clear feedback to users.
userImpact: Users receive clear feedback when workflow task payloads exceed size limits, preventing cryptic runtime errors.
proposedFix: Add validation in the workflow task execution path to detect oversized payloads and fail the task with appropriate error messaging.
keyQuote: SDK should fail workflow task if payloads size it known to be too large
